name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
one_liner: The official library of plug-ins that let the Cursor AI coding tool connect to things like Gmail, Salesforce, and GitHub.
buyer: A dev agency or consultant who builds and sells custom integrations for companies standardizing on AI coding tools.
business_use_cases: An agency builds and sells bespoke Cursor plugins for enterprise tools not yet covered (an internal ERP, say), using this spec as the template.
A consultant audits a company's AI coding setup and configures the official plugins to speed up their engineering org, billing for the setup.
A SaaS company builds its own official plugin following this spec to get listed and discovered by Cursor's developer user base as a growth channel.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid custom-plugin development for companies using Cursor internally.
Offer a 'get your SaaS listed as an official plugin' growth consulting package.

steal_this: Pick one popular SaaS tool without a Cursor plugin yet and ship one this weekend to get early visibility as a go-to integrator.
